tasks.title: code_flow_facts.lua: compute trip_expr in semantic_facts
tasks.detail: At line ~503, replace the hardcoded FlowTripCountUnknown with actual trip count computation. Before the out[#out+1] line, add a compute_trip_expr helper that builds ValueExpr from counted.start, counted.stop, counted.step, counted.stop_exclusive. For step=1 and exclusive: ValueExprBinary('sub', ValueExprValue(stop), ValueExprValue(start)). For non-unit step: ValueExprBinary('div', diff_expr, ValueExprValue(step)). For inclusive: add step adjustment. Attempt to resolve the CodeValueId via existing value defs/consts. If found: produce FlowTripCountExact(trip_value_id, trip_expr, nil). Otherwise: FlowTripCountUnknown(reason, trip_expr). The trip_expr is always populated even when unresolved. Also return FlowTripCountNonNegative when sign is provable.

tasks.title: T015
tasks.detail: Add a new pass c_inject_hints(func_annotations, f_blocks) that runs BEFORE plan_field_hoists (before line 867). Implement three sections: (1) Pointer alignment: for each CBackendPointerAnnotation with Known(N), prepend a CBackendAssign to the defining block: local = CBackendRValueBuiltin(AssumeAligned, {local, literal(N)}). (2) Loop pragmas: for each CBackendLoopAnnotation, inject CBackendComment('#pragma GCC ivdep') at header block if vectorizable; inject '#pragma GCC unroll N' if unroll_hint; inject '#pragma clang loop interleave(count=N)' if interleave_hint. (3) Branch hints: for each CBackendBranchAnnotation, wrap CBackendIfGoto condition: CBackendRValueBuiltin(Expect, {cond, literal(0 or 1)}). Add function stub for tail merging (c_merge_tails) to be implemented later. Wire func_annotations through the c_emission context so c_emit_func can call c_inject_hints before the optimizer pipeline.

tasks.title: emit_c_lower.lua: add c_merge_tails pass for tail plan emission
tasks.detail: Implement c_merge_tails(func_annotations, f_blocks, block_by_label) called from c_inject_hints or after it. For each loop annotation with non-None tail_plan: if CBackendTailPeel(count), inject a pre-loop peel block that handles the first count iterations via a new CBackendBlock with CBackendGoto to main loop header. If CBackendTailScalar, inject a post-loop scalar block after the exit label that handles trip_count % vector_lanes remaining iterations. Tail blocks use standard CBackendBlock/CBackendStmt/CBackendTerminator nodes. Requires trip_count available (from Layer 1 fix) and vector_lanes from ScheduleVector (from Layer 5 fix). When trip_count or vector_lanes are unavailable, skip tail generation gracefully.
